topics.title: Quantum optimization libraries compared: QAOA, QUBO, and annealing
Quantum computing software in 2026: the open-source map

whatItIs: openqaoa is an open-source project in the optimization and qubo category. It is maintained by entropicalabs and primarily looks like a Python codebase. Multi-backend SDK for quantum optimisation

For readers mapping the ecosystem, this resource is useful because it shows how one team approaches optimization and qubo workflows in practice. The repository README emphasizes: A multi-backend python library for quantum optimization using QAOA on Quantum computers and Quantum computer simulators. Check out the OpenQAOA website at https://openqaoa.entropicalabs.com/
whoItsFor: Teams exploring routing, scheduling, allocation, and other combinatorial problems that can be modeled as optimization workloads.
whatYouCanBuild: Understand how this project models constrained optimization problems.
Compare QUBO, QAOA, and hybrid optimization workflows against classical baselines.

codeSamples.title: 01 Workflows Example
codeSamples.source:
#some regular python libraries
import networkx as nx
import numpy as np
from pprint import pprint
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

#import problem classes from OQ for easy problem creation
from openqaoa.problems import MaximumCut, NumberPartition

#import the QAOA workflow model
from openqaoa import QAOA

#import method to specify the device
from openqaoa.backends import create_device
